About Eco-Vida Designs

EcoArchitecture in harmony with nature

With over two decades of experience designing in tropical environments, we approach each project as an opportunity to create spaces that honor both human wellbeing and ecological integrity.

Our practice is rooted in the belief that exceptional architecture emerges from deep understanding of place: its climate, materials, culture, and rhythms. Every design decision we make serves the greater purpose of creating environments that restore and inspire.

From private residences to wellness retreats, our work across Costa Rica, Hawaii, and the wider world shows sustainable design and refined aesthetics working together as essential partners. Our designs have been built around the world.

Learn More About Our Approach
Our Philosophy

Design Principles

The foundational values that guide every project we undertake

Ecological Integration

Every design begins with a deep study of the site's ecosystems, ensuring our structures enhance rather than diminish the natural environment.

Climate Responsiveness

Passive design strategies and natural ventilation reduce energy dependence while maximizing comfort in tropical climates.

Natural Materials

We prioritize locally-sourced, sustainable materials that age gracefully and connect inhabitants to their surroundings.

Depth of practice

Systems & architecture

Systems

Integrated building systems (structure, envelope, MEP, and water) are coordinated early so performance, maintenance, and ecology stay aligned through construction and occupancy.

Accomplishments

From coastal residences to hospitality and retreat work across Costa Rica, Hawaii, and beyond, our portfolio reflects a consistent focus on craft, climate, and context.

Interior Architecture

Materials, light, and flow are treated as part of the architecture: interiors extend the landscape and support daily rituals without competing with the setting.

Exterior Architecture

Roofs, overhangs, outdoor rooms, and landscape edges are designed as one composition, protecting from sun and rain while opening views and connection to place.
